breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet on all four sides vs. periodic). It resolved the conflict by discarding the periodic condition, which aligns with the ground truth. The generated specification explicitly states to enforce the Dirichlet conditions and adds the clarification 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions anywhere'.
